name: smwgraphics-super-castlevania-iv-stage-a-clock-tower-vertical-sections
title: Super Castlevania IV - Stage A (Clock Tower - Vertical Sections)
description:
One of the backgrounds of the iconic Clock Tower, from Super Castlevania IV. Perfect fit for tower levels. It's mostly seen in the vertical sections of the stage.

I recommend using it for vertical levels or very tall horizontal levels. Although it uses two palette rows, only the final three colors of palette 5 are used.

The original background is not that large, but I expanded it to fit Super Mario World.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
